verdict.rationale: Rootly's docs describe the incident timeline as the authoritative chronological record that merges updates from people, systems, automations, and communication channels. Meeting Scribe attaches bridge-call transcripts to the incident, and retrospectives auto-draft a Curated Timeline from incident data, Slack, and transcripts that can be edited in the rich-text collaborative editor (AI blocks can be edited or regenerated). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of editing or annotating individual events on the live incident timeline itself, explicit confirmation that alerts are logged as timeline entries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
